body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer dispatched, quoted verbatim below. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `os-sales` · session `session_01CxBKycaiUpA1yGx1XyoGqX`, as the restart act of #24586. ⛔ Not a claim.

**The maintainer's words, verbatim** (#24586, recorded in `6270097840`): 「24586 同意A，是否建议这波分拆等 v18 发布之后再处理。」 The restart condition (npm `@objectstack/spec` `latest` ≥ 18.0.0) was read true by triage in `6291735609`. The ruling's restart act: "one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines into its owning lane … Each card starts with a fresh seam measurement taken at that time, in #23050's shape." This file was under the line at the ruling (7,943 lines 30 days ago) and is over it now, so the ruling's per-file rule covers it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/plugins/plugin-security` is that lane's), one dispatch per slice.

## Measured (on `origin/main` `123ff6f4e`, 2026-10-22)

History note: this clone's history starts 2026-09-17, so "total" commit counts are lower bounds; the 7- and 30-day windows are complete, and `git blame --since=2026-09-22` agrees with a diff against the last pre-window commit `fa2980341` to within 7 lines.

- **Size and churn:** 10,746 lines (7,943 thirty days ago: +2,803, +35.3%). 20 commits in 7 days, 98 in 30 days. `git blame --since=2026-09-22` attributes 4,847 lines (45.1%) to the last 30 days.
- **Structure:** a 1,247-line module preamble, then one `SecurityPlugin` class (9,499 lines, 124 members). `start()` alone is 3,197 lines: setup and service registration, the main `ql.registerMiddleware` authz middleware (2,203 lines), a second middleware, bootstrap and the org-admin auto-grant. The largest sections:

| section | lines | lines from the last 30 days |
|---|---:|---:|
| `start()`: main `ql` authz middleware | 2,203 | **918** |
| controlled-by-parent (`resolveCbpRelation`, `computeControlledByParentFilter`, `assert*ControlledByParent*`) | 1,541 | 774 |
| module preamble | 1,247 | 571 |
| read filters + field masks + object admission (`getReadFilter`, `canReadObject`, `canWriteObject`, …) | 1,083 | **795** |
| addressed writes + RLS filter layers + tenant wall | 1,075 | 309 |
| baselines + `explainAccessForCaller` + sharing verdicts | 936 | 470 |
| policy collection, object security meta, outage probes | 719 | 259 |
| `start()`: setup + service registration | 623 | 229 |

- **Shared state a split must pass:** `ql` (61 refs), `permissionEvaluator` (57), `logger` (43), `resolvePermissionSetsForContext` (30), `tenancyPosture` (27), the field-name and CBP caches. The `start()` middleware closes over locals and calls into nearly every later section, so it is the costliest slice; the CBP, RLS and read-filter sections share the caches.
- **What reads it by path:** 9 `scripts/` files, including the ADR anchor `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__plugins__plugin-security__src__security-plugin.ts.json` (ADR-0055, ADR-0106, ADR-0123, ADR-0138; its invariant names `resolveCbpRelation`, which a CBP slice moves), `check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`, `check-system-context-census.mjs`, `symbol-anchors.mjs` and three contract baselines; 28 files under `content/` and `docs/`; 171 test files.
- **In flight:** 2 of the 10 open PRs touch the file: #25215 (draft, +560/−297) and #25198 (draft, +191/−191, the CBP read scope). Slices touching their regions wait for them.
- ⚠️ This is a permission boundary. Move-only is the whole contract here: a slice that changes any verdict is out of scope.

## The ask (from #24586's ruling and #23050's shape)

1. **Split along the existing seams,** one area per PR. Each slice is **move-only**: no logic changes.
2. **Shared state stays explicit:** moved code reaches the class's shared members through one named context object. ⛔ Not a second copy of a helper, ⛔ not a re-derivation.
3. **Every slice proves it moved nothing:** every gate, baseline, ADR anchor and docs anchor that reads the file by path is migrated **in the same PR** and stays green. ⛔ A gate whose target moved must not go silently empty.
4. **Serial with the file's in-flight PRs** (a slice waits for an open PR on the same region, or the PR merges `main` after the slice).
5. ⛔ No new gate.

## Not in this card

Any behaviour change. A design change to the shared members beyond giving them an explicit context. Splitting files in other lanes (#24586 hands those to their own seats).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: "split large file move-only service-automation engine.ts security-plugin.ts auth-manager.ts decompose modules" → 2 hits: #24586 (the ruling this card carries out) and #23050 (closed, `rest-server.ts`). **New.**
